text:
marta: Quick thought — for the benchmark blog + webinar next month, let's produce 3 battlecard variants mapped to lead intent: cost-savings, reliability/SLA, and migration from cloud-managed endpoints. Short, actionable bullets only.
kevin: Agree. For cost-savings we should highlight batching + KV cache impact and an apples-to-apples $/1k token figure. Can someone pull the last perf run numbers?
ana: FYI the 8k-seq run with KV prefix caching + dynamic batching showed ~42% lower GPU token compute vs baseline. We can call it 'up to 40% unit-cost reduction' for marketing copy.
ben: Prefer generic competitor language — e.g. 'major cloud-managed endpoints' and 'popular LLM APIs' rather than vendor names in the card. Legal prefers nondisparagement.
julia: Also we need an SDR routing matrix so leads get the right battlecard variant. Draft routing rules below — please sanity-check: 
```yaml
routing_rules:
  - match: '(?i)migrate|on-prem|private|vpc'
    route: Enterprise AE
    card: migration/SLA variant
  - match: '(?i)cost|cheaper|save|savings'
    route: Growth AE
    card: cost-savings variant
  - match: '(?i)latency|reliability|sla|uptime'
    route: Solutions AE
    card: reliability variant
  - default:
    route: SDR queue
    card: overview
```
marta: Nice — can we add a short template line the SDRs can paste? Eg: 'Thanks for reaching out — based on what you mentioned, we have a short note + benchmarking pack for X. Can I connect you to our AE?'
kevin: I'll draft three one-liners tied to the cards. Quick examples: cost -> 'We routinely cut unit inference cost by ~40% with caching + batching', reliability -> 'SLA-backed dedicated nodes and multi-tier fallbacks for production apps', migration -> 'Private/VPC options + lift-and-shift guidance for regulated workloads'. Keep under 140 chars.
ana: For the benchmark narrative in the post, avoid deep infra specifics but call out 'continuous batching, KV cache, and quantization profiles' as the levers. Link to the full tech appendix from the blog.
ben: Webinar hooks: 1) 'How we cut per-token costs without sacrificing latency', 2) 'Scaling RLHF inference at scale: lessons from production', 3) 'Migration playbook: from cloud endpoints to private inference'. Pick one as the hero.
julia: I'll slot 'cost' as hero for the webinar audience (PLG + startup growth). I'll also update the battlecard doc and push to confluence.
sdr-bot: new_lead: id=98421 matched_rule='cost' routed_to='Growth AE' (auto) :white_check_mark:
marta: Perfect. Action items: kevin drafts one-liners (due EOD), julia updates battlecard + confluence page (tomorrow), ana to provide benchmark appendix link, ben to draft webinar outline. We'll reconvene Thurs 11am PT.
kevin: On it.
julia: Assigned.
ana: Uploading appendix link to the thread now: https://redwood-internal/docs/benchmarks/8k-kv-cache-run
ben: I'll sketch slides and a 30-min flow.
marta: Great — let's keep the card language concise and avoid named competitor calls. We'll iterate after the first draft.
